title: UIBubbles extension manifest (0.1-draft)
description: DRAFT. Describes an extension: who it is, how its Bubbles render, what it provides and uses, which events cross a glue wall, and what it asks the host for. A Bubble declares what it wants; the Host decides what it gets.

uibubbles.description: Spec version this manifest is written against.

entry.description: Where the code loads from. Deliberately separate from the id, so moving to a CDN never changes identity.

integrity.description: Subresource-integrity style hash of the entry file.

modes.description: Rendering modes this extension supports. A mode implies no capability.

provides.description: Methods other extensions can call through the host, keyed by method name (dots allowed for nesting).

uses.description: Local aliases for extensions this one calls, like an import map.

emits.description: Events this extension's Bubbles may send across a glue wall.

accepts.description: Events this extension's Bubbles can receive across a glue wall.

network.description: Declared network reach. Anything not listed is refused by the host.

permissions.description: Requested, never granted by declaring. The host decides.

extensionId.description: An https directory URL containing uibubbles.json. Trailing slash, no query or fragment.

kind.description: interactive: opens a Bubble the user acts in; the gesture is the grant. headless: data call that needs a grant in advance.

schemaRef.description: Inline JSON Schema object, or a reference such as a JSContact type.
